fields.name: page-type
fields.label: Page Type
fields.description: The Site Global Template of the page (layout and template code). Overrides the page-type column of the metadata sheet.

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation
fields.description: The header (nav) page of this page and, unless they set their own, its child pages. Empty: the nearest parent page's Navigation (or the metadata sheet's nav column), else the locale's references/nav.

fields.name: footer
fields.label: Footer
fields.description: The footer page of this page and, unless they set their own, its child pages. Empty: the nearest parent page's Footer (or the metadata sheet's footer column), else the locale's references/footer.

fields.name: error-page
fields.label: 404 Page
fields.description: The page shown when a page below this one isn't found. Empty: the nearest parent page's 404 Page (or the metadata sheet's error-page column), else the locale's error-pages/404.
